heroHeadline: Handcrafted Jhalars and Hangings, Made to Order in Howrah
heroIntro: Pom pom garlands, torans, floral jhalars, bead and bell hangings — made to order for weddings, events, pandals and retail displays.
siteTitle: JHALAR | Handcrafted Jhalars, Torans and Hangings — Made in Howrah
siteDescription: Pom pom garlands, torans, floral jhalars, bead and bell hangings — handmade in Howrah and delivered across India. Custom colours and large orders welcome.

faqItems.a: From a few dozen to several thousand pieces per design. Tell us the design and the quantity and we will confirm.

faqItems.q: Can you match a specific colour?
faqItems.a: Yes. Share a reference photo or your palette and we will match it in the sample before production.

faqItems.q: Do you deliver outside West Bengal?
faqItems.a: Yes, we dispatch across India. Tell us where it needs to reach and we will confirm the arrangements.

faqItems.q: How long does an order take?
faqItems.a: It depends on the design and the quantity. Share the date you need it by and we will confirm whether we can meet it.

faqItems.q: How do I place an order?
faqItems.a: Message us on WhatsApp with the design and how many you need. We take it from there.

collection.label: Our Collection
collection.title: Jhalars, Torans, Tassels and More

customOrders.label: Custom Orders

customOrders.intro: Send a reference and your palette. Any design in the collection can be remade in your colours.

steps.title: Send Your Brief

steps.text: Once you approve the sample, we confirm the price and the timeline, and production starts.
